notes.title: Vanaris Tactics Demo is Returning Back!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41118451/3721132cd3a2df4f416ef2699c6f366dcf797d3e.png[/img]

Greetings, Stalwart Tacticians. 

After our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1599860/view/3132817022210875049]first public demo released[/url] in January, we are coming back to show our demo build for this year Steam Next Fest. Follow the story of Morgana, Adrien, and Nigel fighting as refugees for their occupied motherland. Use your tactical prowess to outwit those who stand in the way of obtaining freedom. See how their stories unfold as righteous rebels to fight friends and foes alike. 

Feel free to download and play the demo during the Steam Next Fest [b]until 28th February, 10 am PT.[/b]

[h3][b]Demo build updates: [/b][/h3][list]
[*] Additional bug fixes
[*]New languages added;
> Simplified Chinese
> Traditional Chinese
> German
> Japanese
> Korean
> French
> European Spanish[/list]
In case you haven't watched the trailer, have a look! There might be something new you will discover.
[previewyoutube=4ESP9LUTato;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41118451/d55ed6a295357e1b0f57b3f7e7bb4cc6eb0ef80d.gif[/img]
[i]Take a peek of the conflict between the characters.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41118451/61256d2e14e12770d81a64aee1263e3b619a987c.gif[/img]
[I]Watch out for formidable foes with special abilities![/i]

[h3][b]Do you have any feedback you want to tell us?[/b] [/h3]
Now you can reach us by filling out the form we provide inside the demo. The team appreciates it, as it will help to improve the game much further. 

[b]If you enjoy playing the demo, don't hesitate to wishlist the game! [/b] 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1599860/Vanaris_Tactics/

Stay safe and healthy, Tacticians.
Cheers!

The Vanaris Team. 

[i]Follow us on Twitter![/i]
twitter.com/VanarisTactics 

[i]Join our community![/i]
http://discord.gg/toge
